meta.name: competitive-intel-watch
meta.description: Scheduled delta monitoring against a prior competitive snapshot. Use when tracking competitors on a cadence: material shifts only, cited evidence, battle-card update flags, runs unattended.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定时追踪竞品动态，只推送实质性变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期跟踪竞品并自动生成战报
copy.tagline_en: Track competitors on a schedule, get only material changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor competitors regularly and auto-generate battle cards

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对照上一份竞争对手快照定期扫描，只报告实质性变化，每条附证据链接和日期，并标出需要更新的战卡或定位文档。若无重大变化，会如实报告“无”。
howto.when: 当你想按固定节奏跟踪竞争对手，并附上之前生成的竞争对手快照时触发；也可设定为无人值守定时运行。

say.text: 用上次的快照跑竞争情报监视，告诉我这个季度实际变了什么。
say.note: Claude 会对照快照输出变更清单与证据。

say.text: 设置每月一次竞争情报监视，有实质变化时标出战卡需更新的部分。
say.note: 它会无人值守运行，并返回变更报告。

say.text: 这次重点盯价格变动，基于上次快照运行监视。
say.note: Claude 会过滤掉不重要的变化，只报价格相关重点。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude diffs the current competitive landscape against the previous snapshot, reporting only material shifts with cited URL and date, and flags which battle-card or positioning sections need updating. If nothing major changed, it plainly says so.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to track competitors on a cadence and supply a prior snapshot; can also run unattended on a schedule.

say_en.text: Run the watch against last quarter's snapshot and tell me what actually changed.
say_en.note: Claude returns a changelog with evidence.

say_en.text: Set up a monthly competitor watch that flags when our battle card goes stale.
say_en.note: It runs unattended and reports updates.

say_en.text: Focus this run on pricing moves, based on the prior snapshot.
say_en.note: Claude filters for pricing-related shifts only.
